label: 📊 Analytics Charts
description: Visualizations that close the loop on an analysis: ROC + AUC and precision-recall curves for classifiers, confusion matrix, coefficient + confidence interval plots, calendar heatmaps for time-of-week patterns, treemaps for composition, data-flow Sankey, chord diagrams for closed-set relationships, force-directed network graphs for arbitrary relationships, dendrograms for hierarchical clustering, and KPI cards for executive dashboards. Pairs with stats_pro for the full classification deliverable.
author: DataInsightGrove
